# ferriskey_organization_member_role (Resource)

Assigns a role to a member of an organization. A pure link: any change recreates it. Organization roles are not a separate kind of role: `role_id` is the UUID of an ordinary realm role (`ferriskey_role` without `client_id`) or client role (`ferriskey_role` with `client_id`); both are accepted. The user must already be a member of the organization (see `ferriskey_organization_member`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_organization_member_role" "example" {
  realm           = "acme"
  organization_id = ferriskey_organization.tenant.organization_uuid
  user_id         = ferriskey_organization_member.alice.user_id
  role_id         = ferriskey_role.editor.role_uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) UUID of the organization. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `realm` (String) Realm the organization belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `role_id` (String) UUID of the realm or client role to assign (`role_uuid` of `ferriskey_role`). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `user_id` (String) UUID of the organization member. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{organization_id}/{user_id}/{role_id}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_organization_member_role.example acme/ORG_UUID/USER_UUID/ROLE_UUID
```
